text:
Great location right in the plaza, surrounded by bars and restaurants. The shop is on the second floor with a peaceful view, making it a nice spot to relax.

They have a good selection, although it would be nice to see more local Thai varieties alongside the imported options. The staff was very helpful and knowledgeable, taking time to explain the different choices.

The atmosphere is chill, with reggae music and some games available, which makes it a place you’d want to stay in for a while. Prices are reasonable, and the quality of the products is excellent fresh and well-maintained.

Great cannabis shop right next to Bangla Road in Patong. The staff are genuinely friendly, respectful, and take the time to explain everything properly without pressure. You can really feel they care about giving honest advice and good service, not just making a quick sale.

The atmosphere is relaxed, clean, and welcoming, which makes the whole experience comfortable — especially for first-time visitors. Quality products, fair prices, and trustworthy people.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable place with good vibes and professional service near Bangla.

A strain is a genetic variant or subtype of a microorganism (e.g., a virus, bacterium or fungus). For example, a "flu strain" is a certain biological form of the influenza or "flu" virus. These flu strains are characterized by their differing isoforms of surface proteins. New viral strains can be created due to mutation or swapping of genetic components when two or more viruses infect the same cell in nature.[3] These phenomena are known respectively as antigenic drift and antigenic shift. Microbial strains can also be differentiated by their genetic makeup using metagenomic methods to maximize resolution within species.[4] This has become a valuable tool to analyze the microbiome.

Artificial constructs

Scientists have modified strains of viruses in order to study their behavior, as in the case of the H5N1 influenza virus. While funding for such research has aroused controversy at times due to safety concerns, leading to a temporary pause
